# §14-80.35.19. Redistricting - Senate composition.
The State Senate shall be composed of forty-eight (48) members elected from the districts hereinafter described. The following delineation of areas to be included in each Senate district is based on the official counties, tracts, blockgroups, and blocks as defined by the United States Bureau of the Census. The forty-eight (48) Senate districts shall consist of the counties, tracts, blockgroups, and blocks next described: District 1 Population
